mike_h: Quick canary update — rolled canary v2 to 3% at 08:12 PT.
mike_h: Seeing a small spike of 500s on /generate, ~0.9% error rate (~60 err/min). Not sure if it's infra or model. Investigating.
kevin_p: :eyes: Checking pool-a metrics now. Any traces? Could be OOMs from batching.
jia_w: I pulled recent logs, i see these errors repeatedly:
jia_w: ```
ERROR 2026-03-17T15:12:45Z worker-7 kernel: kvcache failed: oom when allocating 128MB
500 POST /generate 0.45s trace_id=tr_abc123
```
mike_h: good catch. We saw memory climb before errors. We bumped batch_size for the canary & restarted the slice at 08:18 PT.
ana_pm: tagging @ana_pm for product impact — any sessions impacted? :phone_off_hook:
ana_pm: (that's me) One customer reported a 1–2 min slowdown, no data loss. Watch for regressions.
kevin_p: I'm going to revert the batch_size tweak for the canary and enable strict GC on that pool. Will update in 1–2m.
deploy-bot: deploy status: canary v2 -> 3% (started 08:12 PT) | 08:20 PT action: rollback-batch-tweak requested by kevin_p
mike_h: thanks. Blocker = model batching config. Next: monitor 5m error-rate and confirm if stable. If errors <0.2% at 5% traffic, proceed to 10%.
jia_w: I'll set an alert for >0.5% sustained over 2m and post traces to #incidents if triggered.
kevin_p: I opened PR #4823 with the batch config rollback and GC flag — requesting quick review @mike_h.
mike_h: reviewing now. If good, let's run canary to 5% at 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: rolling restart scheduled on pool-a nodes in 10m for memory reclaim.
mike_h: thanks everyone — will post a short follow up after the 5m window.
